faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella in 2037?
faq.a: The maximum passenger capacity across our fleet is 12 persons. This limit applies to boats like the Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Ferretti 94 (29m), and Canados 86 (26m). Smaller vessels such as the Dubhe (8m) carry a maximum of 5 passengers.

faq.q: Are there any boats that can take more than 12 passengers?
faq.a: No. All boats in our fleet are licensed for a maximum of 12 passengers. This is a strict legal limit under Spanish maritime regulations and insurance requirements. Even larger vessels like the Ferretti 94 (29m) are capped at 12 passengers.

faq.q: What is the smallest boat available for a group of 5?
faq.a: For a group of 5, the Dubhe (8m) or the Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are ideal. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. The Dubhe is a motorboat; the Mariah is a speedboat. Neither offers a jet ski.

faq.q: Do children count toward the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes. Under Spanish maritime law, every person on board, regardless of age, counts toward the maximum passenger capacity. Infants are included in the count. Always confirm the exact number of guests when booking.

faq.q: Can I book two boats to accommodate a larger group?
faq.a: Yes. If your group exceeds 12 persons, you can charter two or more boats simultaneously. We can coordinate departures from Puerto Banús so that boats travel together. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange multi-boat bookings.

faq.q: Which boats include a free jet ski?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (white and grey variants) and the K80 (24m) include a free jet ski with the charter. These boats have a minimum booking of 4 hours starting at €4,719. The jet ski is towed behind the boat and can be used on request.

faq.q: What is included in the price for a Tier A boat?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The price includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA.

faq.q: Do all boats depart from the same marina?
faq.a: Yes. Every boat in our fleet departs from Puerto Banús. There are no departures from Marbella Marina, Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande. Puerto Banús is the main luxury marina on the Costa del Sol, located just west of Marbella.

Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol in 2037? Knowing the exact marbella boat rental group size limits 2037 is essential before you book. Every boat in our fleet has a strict maximum passenger capacity, ranging from 5 to 12 persons, enforced by Spanish maritime law and insurance. This guide covers all boats, their limits, pricing tiers, and departure details so you can pick the right vessel without surprises.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. Boats depart exclusively from Puerto Banús – no other ports are available.

Pricing Tiers for 2037

Our fleet is divided into two pricing tiers. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are the most affordable, costing €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 white and grey) start at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and include a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request – contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

What Affects Group Size Limits?

Capacity is determined by the boat's safety certification, not just its physical size. Spanish maritime law sets a maximum number of persons based on the vessel's design, stability, and life raft capacity. Insurance policies also enforce these limits strictly – exceeding them voids coverage. Even on a 29-metre Ferretti 94, the limit is 12 passengers.

Children and Infants Count

Every person on board, including infants and children, counts toward the maximum. There are no exemptions. If your group includes children under 12, ensure the total number of guests (adults plus children) does not exceed the boat's limit. Life jackets are provided for all ages.

Booking for Groups Larger Than 12

If your party exceeds 12, you can charter two or more boats simultaneously. We can coordinate departures from Puerto Banús so that boats travel together to destinations like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. This is a popular option for weddings, corporate events, and large family reunions. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange multi-boat bookings.

Departure Port: Puerto Banús

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, the luxury marina on the Golden Mile. There are no departures from Marbella Marina, Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande. Puerto Banús offers ample parking, restaurants, and easy access to the Mediterranean. From here, you can cruise to the coast of Marbella, the dunes of Cabopino, or further west to Estepona.
